command: set -o pipefail; echo '=== IDENTITY ==='; hostname; whoami; date -Is; echo '=== ENTITYOS SERVICE ==='; systemctl is-active entityos-vm.service || true; systemctl show entityos-vm.service -p ActiveState -p SubState -p MainPID -p FragmentPath -p DropInPaths -p ExecCondition -p ExecStartPre -p ExecStopPost --no-pager || true; echo '=== EFFECTIVE UNIT ==='; systemctl cat entityos-vm.service --no-pager 2>&1 | sed -n '1,240p'; echo '=== GUARD FILES ==='; for p in /etc/systemd/system/entityos-vm.service.d/10-volatile-state-guard.conf /usr/local/libexec/entityos/fluechtig-vor-start-pruefen.sh; do if sudo -n test -e "$p" 2>/dev/null; then echo PRESENT:$p; sudo -n stat -c '%n|%s|%y|%a|%U:%G' "$p"; sudo -n sha256sum "$p"; else echo ABSENT:$p; fi; done; echo '=== SEMANTIC SQLITE SUBJECTS ==='; for p in /var/lib/entityos/rootfs-run/root/.local/share/agentzero/consciousness.db /var/lib/entityos/rootfs-run/root/.local/share/agentzero/unified.db /var/lib/entityos/rootfs-run/root/.local/share/frank/db/amygdala.db /var/lib/entityos/rootfs-run/root/.local/share/frank/db/world_experience.db /var/lib/entityos/data/unified.db; do if sudo -n test -f "$p" 2>/dev/null; then echo PRESENT:$p; sudo -n stat -c '%n|%s|%y' "$p"; sudo -n sha256sum "$p"; else echo ABSENT:$p; fi; done; echo '=== SELF-INTEGRATION ==='; if test -d /home/andreas/self-integration/.git; then git -C /home/andreas/self-integration rev-parse HEAD; git -C /home/andreas/self-integration status --short; fi; systemctl --user is-active grid10-selbsttests.timer 2>/dev/null || true; systemctl --user show grid10-selbsttests.service -p Result -p ExecMainStatus -p ActiveState -p SubState --no-pager 2>/dev/null || true; echo '=== ARCHITEKT ==='; systemctl --user show frankenstein-architekt.service -p Result -p ExecMainStatus -p ActiveState -p SubState --no-pager 2>/dev/null || true; journalctl --user -u frankenstein-architekt.service -n 30 --no-pager 2>/dev/null | tail -30 || true
